p: The evidence found by Bai Zhuangyuan Space shows that he is investigating how to quickly repay his debts

The evidence found in the Zhen Ji grocery store is borrowed 50000 yuan from Mr. Zhen today and should be returned as soon as possible. One month later, on October 7, 1998, a total of 200000 yuan, including principal and interest, needs to be repaid. If the repayment is delayed, interest will be calculated at a daily rate of 10%. The promissory note of Bai Zhuangyuan on September 7, 1998, has different handwriting in the first and second sentences.

The evidence found at the Zhen Ji grocery store shows that there are still many beer bottles here, many beer bottles on the table, some of which have been spilled, and a small amount of beer and water stains on the ground at the feet of the deceased.
